title: Constitutional evolution: more provisions and persons

boxes.title: Company era: added detail
items: **1772** trigger: famine, revenue fall; Company sought loan of about **£1 million**
1773: based on **Lord North** committee; ==banned **private trade** and **bribes**==; Supreme Court = **1 CJ + 3 judges**
**Amending Act 1781** (Act of Settlement): judicial and executive functions separated
1784: territories = **"British possessions in India"**; **Board of Control** = **6** members
1793: Board of Control salaries from **Indian revenue**; override power extended to all GGs + Governors
1833 (**Saint Helena Act**): **Law Commission** = origin of Law Ministry; "final step towards centralisation"
1853: no fixed term; territories held =="in trust for Her Majesty"== (APPSC-GS **2018**)

boxes.title: 1861-1919: added detail
head: Act
Point
rows: Indirect election = nomination on recommendation of universities, municipalities, chambers
==**Minto**: "Father of Communal Electorate"==; Morley = Secretary of State
Total **69**: **37** officials, **32** non-officials; official majority at Centre
**3 of 6** Executive Council members Indian; review after **10 years**

items.what: ==**Simon Commission**== (two years early): **7** members, all white; "Simon Go Back"

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: 1833 kept "tea and China" = ⚠ trap; that was **1813**
Elected representation = ==**1909**== (2018 key); 1909: **no** dyarchy, no provincial autonomy
Responsible provincial govts ending dual rule = **1935** (APPSC-GS **2025**)
Last Viceroy: **Mountbatten**; Ministry of Law origin: Charter Act **1833** (IYB **2026**)
